cohort: The study participants were 173 infants born at less than 32 weeks' gestation.
finding: Neonatal thyroid dysfunction, specifically significantly higher mean thyrotropin levels, was observed in preterm infants exposed to topical iodine prior to caesarean section, but not following exposure to iodinated contrast media.
mod_finding: Mean thyrotropin levels were significantly higher in infants exposed to topical iodine prior to caesarean section.
followup_time: up to the equivalent of 36 weeks' gestation
